scoring_note: scoring.json was produced once, from local data. agent/answer_key.py reads column names from data/processed/X_test.parquet, which is not committed, so it cannot be recomputed from a fresh clone. The hashes above identify every file it was built from.

stripped.why: Opaque encoded blobs the API returns with each thinking block, used when a conversation is continued on the same model. A reader cannot use them. They were 43.6% of the bytes of the runs' messages.json files.

reasoning_note: Thinking blocks hold summaries, not raw reasoning: the runner asked for summarised display (agent/llm.py, THINKING). In firstlight and run1 every thinking summary is empty in the record.

cannot_carry.why: Manifests store only its length (system_prompt_chars). Re-rendering it from the code at each run's commit would be a reconstruction, not the record.

cannot_carry.what: per-turn token usage for every run except run11-honest-cached
cannot_carry.why: Manifests hold totals only. The Layer 3 ledger recorded run11's requests one by one, so only that run carries it.

cannot_carry.what: tool results for calls in the final turn of stopped runs
cannot_carry.why: The run was stopped before those calls executed, so no result exists.

cannot_carry.what: a final answer turn for run9-honest-nopop
cannot_carry.why: It hit the turn limit after its last tool results were returned, so no assistant turn follows them.
